heading: Inservice enrollment in a program of education

tree.text: A member of the Armed Forces who— may receive educational assistance under this chapter for enrollment in an approved program of education while continuing to perform the duty described in section 3011(a)(1)(A)(i)(I) 1 or 3012(a)(1)(A)(ii) of this title.

children.text: first becomes a member or first enters on active duty as a member of the Armed Forces after June 30, 1985, and does not make an election under section 3011(c)(1) or section 3012(d)(1);
completes at least two years of service on active duty after such date;
after such service, continues on active duty or in the Selected Reserve without a break in service (except as described in section 3012(b)(2) of this title); and
but for section 3011(a)(1)(A)(i)(I) 1 or 3012(a)(1)(A)(ii) of this title would be eligible for basic educational assistance,

tree.text: A member of the Armed Forces who— may, after December 31, 1989, receive educational assistance under this chapter for enrollment in an approved program of education while continuing to perform the duty described in section 3012(a)(1)(B)(ii) of this title.

children.text: as of December 31, 1989, is eligible for educational assistance benefits under chapter 34 of this title;
after June 30, 1985, has served the two years required by section 3012(a)(1)(B)(i); and
but for section 3012(a)(1)(B)(ii) of this title would be eligible for basic educational assistance,

tree.text: A member of the Armed Forces who— may receive such assistance for enrollment in an approved program of education while continuing to perform the service described in section 3018(b)(2) of this title.

children.text: completes at least two years of service on active duty after June 30, 1985;
after such service continues on active duty without a break in service; and
but for section 3018(b)(3)(A) of this title would be entitled to basic educational assistance under this chapter,

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 3011(a)(1)(A)(i), referred to in subsec. (a), was amended generally by Pub. L. 106–419, title I, § 103(a)(1)(A), Nov. 1, 2000, 114 Stat. 1825, and, as so amended, does not contain a subcl. (I).

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1991—Pub. L. 102–83, § 5(a), renumbered section 1416 of this title as this section. Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 102–83, § 5(c)(1), substituted “3011(c)(1)” for “1411(c)(1)”, “3012(d)(1)” for “1412(d)(1)”, “3012(b)(2)” for “1412(b)(2)”, and “3011(a)(1)(A)(i)(I) or 3012(a)(1)(A)(ii)” for “1411(a)(1)(A)(i)(I) or 1412(a)(1)(A)(ii)” in two places. Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 102–83, § 5(c)(1), substituted “3012(a)(1)(B)(i)” for “1412(a)(1)(B)(i)” and “3012(a)(1)(B)(ii)” for “1412(a)(1)(B)(ii)” in two places. Subsec. (c). Pub.
